recommendation: Keep the human-review audit commit. The work group should resolve FHIR-57389 or a successor issue to decide whether DiagnosticReport should directly reference ImagingSelection and, if so, which element and search/narrative updates are required.
issue_request: FHIR-6246 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification DSTU1 Imaging Integration request to add ImagingObjectSelection as a DiagnosticReport.imagingStudy choice. The decisive comments preserved DiagnosticReport.imagingStudy as the full DICOM study link while allowing ImagingObjectSelection as an alternative key-image mechanism, with O&O left to choose how to provide the link.
initial_application: Commit ae4866b512efb6620d418a4870b8d2c14ba9984a preapplied #6246 by changing the old DiagnosticReport spreadsheet's imagingStudy type from Reference(ImagingStudy) to Reference(ImagingStudy|imagingObjectSelection) and adding an overlap note. Related commit 165f27cb02e9a41309bffb199dbf6aa7f36c54f2 added the DiagnosticReport notes text for FHIR-7682, and commit 7da3e85d1128fc712018adcaa1883b9d9203cb3d later renamed the target to ImagingManifest.
additional_context: FHIR-14080 later removed ImagingManifest from active FHIR-core resources, and current fhir.ini lists both imagingmanifest and ImagingObjectSelection under removed/dropped resources. FHIR-17183 introduced ImagingSelection as a separate active R5 resource but did not decide DiagnosticReport references. Current DiagnosticReport.study is Reference(ImagingStudy) only, current DiagnosticReport.media.link is Reference(DocumentReference) only, and current diagnostics guidance discusses ImagingSelection through Observation imaging profiles. FHIR-57389, currently Waiting for Input and unresolved, asks exactly whether baseline DiagnosticReport should directly relate to ImagingSelection and lists media, supportingInfo, and results as candidate mechanisms.
reconciliation: No source change was made. A literal edit would revive retired ImagingObjectSelection/ImagingManifest behavior, while adding ImagingSelection to DiagnosticReport now would make a new conformance decision before the current work-group question is resolved.

related_jiras.note: Asked to reference key images from DiagnosticReport, pointed back to FHIR-6246, and supplied the overlap notes that were later carried forward in edited form.
Removed ImagingManifest from active FHIR-core, making a literal restoration of the old target inappropriate.
Introduced active ImagingSelection as a separate R5 resource but did not settle DiagnosticReport reference placement.
Updated DiagnosticReport.study for R6 and kept it ImagingStudy-only while removing the older overlap comment from the element definition.
Unresolved current issue asking whether DiagnosticReport should have a direct relationship to ImagingSelection and which element should carry it.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Persuasive with Modification request to add ImagingObjectSelection to DiagnosticReport.imagingStudy, later clarified as preserving imagingStudy for full studies while allowing an alternative key-image mechanism.
evidence_items.learned: This establishes the seed request and the historical work-group intent that the current source check must reconcile.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Not Persuasive with Modification issue for key-image references in DiagnosticReport; resolution says see FHIR-6246 and add an overlap note.
evidence_items.learned: This confirms the related 2015 DiagnosticReport key-image issue was handled as part of the same change family.

evidence_items.summary: Historical commits added ImagingObjectSelection to DiagnosticReport.imagingStudy, added the related notes text, and later renamed ImagingObjectSelection to ImagingManifest.
evidence_items.learned: FHIR-6246 had a concrete old-source application before later resource removal and replacement work changed the current target surface.

evidence_items.summary: Current build configuration lists DiagnosticReport, ImagingSelection, and ImagingStudy as active resources and lists imagingmanifest and ImagingObjectSelection among removed/dropped resources.
evidence_items.learned: A literal source fix targeting ImagingObjectSelection or ImagingManifest would be outside current build scope.

evidence_items.summary: Current DiagnosticReport.study targets ImagingStudy only, media.link targets DocumentReference only, and the notes distinguish ImagingStudy from media without naming ImagingSelection.
evidence_items.learned: The current source has no direct DiagnosticReport-to-ImagingSelection target, but the appropriate current element is not determined by FHIR-6246 alone.

evidence_items.summary: Waiting for Input/Unresolved R6 issue asks whether DiagnosticReport should directly relate to ImagingSelection and lists media, supportingInfo, and results as possible mechanisms.
evidence_items.learned: The current ImagingSelection linkage is an active unresolved work-group question, so an automatic source edit would be unsafe.

evidence_items.summary: Later final decision removed ImagingManifest from active core and has already been audited on the combined branch.
evidence_items.learned: This explains why the old FHIR-6246 target should not be restored in current source.

evidence_items.summary: Later final decision introduced ImagingSelection as a distinct active R5 resource and has already been audited on the combined branch.
evidence_items.learned: ImagingSelection is the current active resource family, but FHIR-17183 did not itself authorize a DiagnosticReport target.

evidence_items.summary: The Imaging Integration/O&O agenda records 'Add ImagingSelection to DiagnosticReport.media?' as a topic during a joint check-in.
evidence_items.learned: Community context supports that current DiagnosticReport-to-ImagingSelection linkage is a design question rather than a mechanical old-issue replay.

evidence_items.summary: A 2017 discussion described two then-current DiagnosticReport image-linking approaches: imagingStudy to ImagingManifest or image to Media.
evidence_items.learned: The historical community model used now-retired or renamed surfaces, supporting caution before mapping the old issue directly onto current ImagingSelection.
